D. India’s chaotic traffic

comments.text:
India should be viewed in terms of both North and South India, as there are significant differences between the two regions. The places shown in this video are predominantly from North India, whereas many parts of South India are considerably more developed, cleaner, and better maintained.

In addition, India has significant social and economic inequality. While some people live a life of great luxury, others live in conditions similar to those shown in this video. Therefore, it is difficult to generalize the living conditions of the entire country based on a few places or regions.
